title: Dielectric molecular-bridges enable durable inverted perovskite solar cells with 26.60% efficiency and a high reverse breakdown voltage
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,338-348
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02610E, Paper
Chuan Luo, Yu Chen, Xing Wu, Yang Peng, Jing Zhou, Yuwei Duan, Yang Shen, Hongxiang Li, Yihui Wu, Qiang Peng
Bis(4-fluorophenyl)chlorophosphine was introduced for increasing perovskite dielectric constant, delivering 26.60% efficiency with a maximum transient reverse breakdown voltage of −6.6 V for perovskite solar cells.
